reader_summary.headline: He decided early on that the location had to be exceptional.
reader_summary.overview: He decided early on that the location had to be exceptional. He looked at a few good options, backed away when he realized he was forcing them to feel right, and waited, he says. He got that spot, which will be called Little Mountain, after working for nearly a year to secure the long lease he wanted.

thesis: The text argues that Graham Duncan, now Chairman Emeritus of East Rock, utilizes a distinctive investing style focused on assessing people rather than evaluating companies or ideas. It details his rigorous process of 'talent sniping' and reference checking, which has enabled him to identify and seed high-performing investment firms and key hires across the industry.
